title: Sweet and Sour Tofu with Pineapple and Peppers
summary: A vegan Chinese-style dinner with crisp-edged tofu, juicy pineapple and colourful peppers in a glossy tangy-sweet sauce. It is quick enough for a weeknight and great served with rice.

ingredients.name: cornstarch, for coating tofu and thickening sauce
red bell pepper, cut into chunks
green bell pepper, cut into chunks

steps: Pat the tofu dry with kitchen paper, then toss it with 2 tbsp cornstarch, the salt and black pepper until lightly coated on all sides.

Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a large non-stick frying pan or wok over medium-high heat. Fry the tofu for 8–10 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden and crisp on several sides. Transfer to a plate.
In a bowl, whisk together the ketchup, rice vinegar, soy sauce, brown sugar, 1 tbsp cornstarch and vegetable stock until smooth.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp vegetable oil to the pan. Stir-fry the onion and peppers for 4–5 minutes until bright and just tender but still a little crisp.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the pineapple and cook for 1 minute to warm through.
Pour in the sauce and simmer for 2–3 minutes, stirring, until glossy and thick enough to coat the vegetables.
Return the tofu to the pan and toss gently for 1–2 minutes until coated and hot, keeping the tofu as intact as possible.
Scatter with sliced spring onion and serve immediately, ideally with steamed rice.
